name: Manage Skills (self-improvement)
summary: Create, update, delete your own skills. Called automatically before unknown tasks (skill-first) and after improvisation.

steps.note: See what exists. Check version numbers.
write_skill(skill_id, name, summary, triggers, steps, notes). Version auto-increments on update. skill_id: snake_case, unique.
delete_skill(skill_id) removes from SKILLS/ and seeds. Use when a skill is wrong or superseded.

notes: SKILL-FIRST: call write_skill BEFORE executing an unknown task type, not after
Steps should reference actual tool names (web_search, fetch_image_url, etc.)
Always include a 'notes' array with gotchas and constraints learned from experience
Triggers determine when read_my_brain auto-suggests this skill — be specific
